description: Everything about one catalog template: description, tier and price, length, formats, its scenes (what each shows, when), every field it takes (texts with their limits, images with their shape, colors, choices, clips) and, when it has them, the safe adjustments (tweaks). With images: true, its timelapse (the whole video in one picture) comes back inside the answer.

images.description: Also return the template's timelapse image inside the answer.
